plain: A person guilty of a crime or wrong

webster.text: A person arraigned in court for a crime.

more.text: Any person convicted of a crime; a criminal.

example.quote: Is the sovereignty of the state to be arraigned like a culprit, or private offender?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
